Junior Chris Lambert ran a superb first leg and John Regis responded with a huge rush down the back straight. Clean takeovers by Drew Walcott and Jason Fergus saw a season's best time of 40.43 with the Newham boys 5m down.

We used the same team as Match 4 League with Chris Lambert as lead-off and then the long relay boys clinched a memorable victory. Good to see Dave Nolan run the first leg in his only outing of the season ruined by injury.

Left: Chris Lambert, 17 years of age and here running to a Surrey Championship win, had a marvellous season. He finished up as 5th ranked under 20 in Britain over 100m with 10.61 and 4th ranked over 200m with 21.56. What a prospect!
